com.esignal.jstandard.managers

Interface NewsManager

  • All Superinterfaces:
    ResourceManager

    public interface NewsManager
extends ResourceManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the News Headlines and Stories.

    NewsManager allows users to request News, subscribe News and request Story for a given News. It is in the form of a traditional asynchronous response. NewsRequestListener or NewsListener is required to be passed as part of the request,subscribe and getStory methods. Also, NewsRequest object should be populated with appropriate request , search criteria and filtering options information e.g. request search criteria, turnaround etc. for requesting and subscribing to News.

    StoryRequest object should be populated with appropriate request information e.g. storyId, turnaround and story format.

    News and story response is sent to the listeners onResponse() method for the request and to the onUpdate method for the subscribe queries. News response information is wrapped as a List of Headline objects that can be retrieved using the HeadlineEvent. Also, All request and subscribe calls are treated separately, they do not depend on each other, thus if the same listener instance is being used on multiple requests than it's clients responsibility to manage onResponse() per symbol.

    We will run through a simple usage of NewsManager. Let's create a factory first. The getFactory() method will retrieves the default implementation of the Factory. The implementation can be changed by calling other getFactory(...) methods OR overriding property "jstandard.resourcemanagerfactory.name" in jstandard.properties. ResourceManagerFactory factory = ResourceManagerFactory.getFactory();

    Now create a NewsManager using the factory. NewsManager newsManager = factory.createNewsManager();

    To start the connection we now need to create instances of ConnectionSettings and ConnectionListener. (Implement MyConnectionListener) ConnectionSettings myConnectionSettings = new ConnectionSettings("myhost", "myusername", "mypassword"); //If proxy settings are required //myConnectionSettings.setProxyInfo("phost", pport, "puser", "ppass"); ConnectionListener myConnectionListener = new MyConnectionListener(); newsManager.connect(myConnectionSettings, myConnectionListener); At the start the connection listener will receive an event of connecting and after successful connection connected event.

    To get the response for the news request, let's make a request to the NewsManager. But before that we also need to have an implementation of the NewsRequestListener. Fill the NewsRequest object and pass it to the manager along with the NewsRequestListener: 

     
        // for request
        NewsRequestListener myNewsRequestListener = new MyNewsRequestListener();
        // for subscribe
        NewsListener myNewsListener = new MyNewsListener();
        
        // for story request
        NewsRequestListener myStoryRequestListener = new MyNewsRequestListener();
        
        Long turnAround = generateUniqueTurnAround();
        NewsRequest newsRequest = new DefaultNewsRequest(turnAround);
        
        // Here is some sample request / subscribe values
        List<String> symbols = new ArrayList<String>();
        symbols.add("IBM");
        symbols.add("AAPL");
        newsRequest.setSymbols(symbols);
        List<String> categories = new ArrayList<String>();
        categories.add("business");
        newsRequest.setCategories(categories);
        newsRequest.setHeadlineDays(10);
                
        newsRequest.setSearch("business");
        newsRequest.setSearchFields(NEWS_SEARCH_FIELDS.HEADLINE);
        newsRequest.setSearchExactPhrase(true);
        newsRequest.setFullTextQuery(true);
        
        //for subscribing do
        newsManager.subscribe(newsRequest, myNewsListener);
        //for request 
        newsManager.request(newsRequest, myNewsRequestListener);
        
        //for story 
        Long turnAround = generateUniqueTurnAround();
        StoryRequest storyRequest = new DefaultStoryRequest(turnAround);
        storyRequest.setStoryID("MTO097u7946");
        newsManager.getStory(storyRequest, myStoryRequestListener);
    The listeners will be receiving the response for the request/subscribe and getStory queries.

    To receive the response data please implement NewsRequestListener' onResponse method for Headline and story and the NewsListener onUpdate method and all other methods. From HeadlineEvent get the response object which should have the Headline response information. The response object is of type List<News>. 

     
        public void onResponse(HeadlineEvent headlineEvent) {
                if(log.isDebugEnabled()) {
                        log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize("News Request listener responded with Headlines:"));
                        List<Headline> headlinesList = headlineEvent.getHeadlines();
                        for(Headline headline : headlinesList)
                                log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize(headline));
                }       
        }
        
        
        public void onUpdate(HeadlineEvent headlineEvent) {
                if(log.isDebugEnabled()) {
                        log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize("News listener updated with Headlines:"));
                        List<Headline> headlinesList = headlineEvent.getHeadlines();
                        for(Headline headline : headlinesList)
                                log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize(headline));
                }
                
        }
        
        public void onResponse(StoryEvent storyEvent) {
                if(log.isDebugEnabled()) {
                        log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize("News Request listener responded with story:"));
                        List<Story> storyList = storyEvent.getStories();
                        for(Story story : storyList)
                                log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize(story));
                }
        }

    Disconnect from the news manager in the end. newsManager.disconnect();
